mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 4.0% signals tight monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
